'''Arden''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. Around [[3640 BBY]] he contacted Captain [[Elson]] on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] and informed him and a Republic citizen that an Imperial transport, which held two SIS agents captive, was recently shot down and that an escape pod was launched out. Arden and Elson believed that the agents hid vital information in the pod, so they send the citizen to find and retrieve it.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Captain Arden appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a hologram during the mission "Freeze Out The Empire" on Hoth.
